component.name: Markdown Viewer
component.summary: Fast, lightweight markdown viewer for Linux

description.p: A fast, lightweight markdown viewer built with Rust and egui. Designed for distraction-free reading with excellent typography and syntax highlighting.

ul.li: GitHub Flavored Markdown with syntax highlighting (200+ languages)
Tab system for multiple documents
File explorer sidebar
Outline / table-of-contents sidebar
Dark and light themes
Live reload on file changes
Session persistence
Native X11 and Wayland support
Mermaid diagrams, math, and image rendering

screenshot.caption: Dark mode with mermaid diagram, file explorer, and outline
LaTeX math rendered inline via typst
Tables with inline code and hyperlinks

ul.li: Thai text renders instead of empty boxes, and Hebrew uses a proportional font instead of a monospace one
With Full Width off, text after a display formula wraps at the reading column again
Long documents with formulas scroll all the way to their last line
With Full Width off, the reading column is centered and lists and headings wrap at its edge
The scrollbar is always shown, so the column no longer shifts at the scroll edges
The tab bar can be hidden from the View menu; Ctrl+E switches between Preview and Edit
Plain email addresses become clickable links
Links inside headings are drawn inline at heading size, and bare URLs in headings are linked
Emoji followed by the text-presentation selector stay monochrome
Bare URLs written without link syntax are clickable, as on GitHub
The red heart emoji renders in color
Emoji render in full color from the system's Noto Color Emoji font
A Preview / Edit toggle turns a tab into a plain Markdown editor, saved with Ctrl+S
Tables fill the pane, and Full Width is the default
A window on a hidden Wayland workspace no longer freezes when its file changes
One Fonts menu with presets, text sizes and a family picker
Font presets resolve against the fonts installed on the system
Wide tables no longer slide under the sidebar
Choose the document font from every installed system font
Links with a #fragment land on the heading they name
List markers line up with their item text
Copy a link's address from its context menu
Dense tables take much less vertical space
Links to missing or undecodable targets are reported instead of ignored
Viewport-clipped rendering restored for long documents
Table columns sized from content, long cell text wraps instead of scrolling away
Tables follow the Full Width setting together with prose
YAML frontmatter renders as a key/value table
Formula size adjustable independently of UI zoom
Selection highlight and link colors customizable
Font fallback discovered from the platform instead of hardcoded family names
Local Markdown references, including bare and percent-encoded paths, open in the viewer
Cross-platform prebuilt binaries (Linux, macOS Intel/arm64, Windows)
One-line installer script for Linux and macOS
SHA256 checksums on every release artifact
AUR package now auto-published from CI
Flatpak manifest ready for Flathub submission
